fixture_setup.repository: Use test/runtime-fake.mjs harbor with tests/place-order.json and its actual source capture; synthetic identities only. Add storyTest(repo, second) only in mixed-scope cases.
fixture_setup.wire: Use existing fakeRuntime POST/GET spies and fake.lint per-test/program admission. Attach complete v1 reports under result.capabilities and/or the legacy report.lint.tests entry as each case states. Echo the actual request IDs and lint command; default confirmed engine_sha is the build in report_template. Never accept a fixture as proof of live engine behavior.
fixture_setup.source: Construct each fake report source natively from exact captured effective sources: hash the selected scenario bytes and each selected returned file. Keep the server closure digest opaque: use the fixed synthetic 64-hex value below. This fixture is not a parser/projection proof. Compare actual uploaded archive bytes to capture; never take source data from an expected output or hash archive bytes as a closure.
fixture_setup.mutations: Each named replacement below changes fake transport input before the real public function runs. It is not a final classification argument. Supply sourceFiles only from actual captured bytes for native pure calls. Unknown build/version reports use aggregate and all row verdicts unknown with reason engine-build-unknown. Incomplete ordinary reports use unknown/analysis-unavailable rows. source:null is complete:false with unknown analysis; keep concrete mode/binding/source blockers only when the delivered contract permits them. Deliberately malformed/conflicting report cases are the named exceptions; never accidentally present an inconsistent report as a valid server state.
fixture_setup.effects: Snapshot approval files and behavioral evidence records before each command. Observe actual requests, streams, current/saved source and state; no model, resource or live service is used.

criteria.text: A selected test with its own normal lint pass, complete supported compatibility and matching captured source and confirmed job build can start paid work; its business result still requires execution.
A selected invalid-source, unsupported-capability or missing-binding blocker stops that test before any paid check or Simulator setup is sent and exits 4 when it is the only selected test.

A selected report that is absent, malformed, conflicting, incomplete or unknown, or whose source/build association is unavailable or mismatched, stops new paid work and exits 5 after lint ends; unfinished or lost lint keeps exit 3 and same-ID recovery.
One blocked or unchecked test does not stop an independently admitted selected test, and unrelated inventory diagnostics do not become selected blockers.
The same selected gate applies to new checks, Simulator setup, saved-lint continuation, retry and a confirmed restart replacement, with the same saved source, owner and dispatch guards.
Compatibility analysis sends no wider source archive, supplies no missing fixture fact, alters no approval or behavioral evidence record, and never retries an uncertain paid dispatch.
Unproved installed-engine, host or physical-observation claims stay unproved without a new global proof gate; known source/build disagreement still blocks structural admission.

cases.given: Matching source/build complete supported selected report and normal own lint pass. Run real runCheck and runTry independently against fake transport; check fake job then returns one passed criterion.
cases.required_observation: Exactly one selected /v1/check or /v1/try setup POST after lint, with original immutable archive and normal request identity/guards. Actual returned check alone supplies criterion evidence. Missing physical attestation alone does not hold this structurally admitted synthetic case.

cases.given: Repeat each invalid-source/source-admission-refused, unsupported-capability/retained-mutation-unsupported, and resource-edge missing-binding/binding-missing input in lint, check and Try entry paths. Source/build association matches.
cases.required_observation: Selected lint outcome refused; standalone/check/Try exit 4; zero /v1/check and /v1/try setup POSTs, no paid request ID allocated, no product effects. Keep precise blocker and client advice.

cases.given: Repeat absent, malformed, conflict, incomplete, engine-build-unknown, source:null, unavailable sourceFiles and exact source/build/version disagreements. Lint job is terminal with own legacy pass.
cases.required_observation: Compatibility never admits. Terminal selected outcome not_run and command exit 5, zero paid/setup POSTs and zero paid calls. Preserve reported server facts and client issue; do not silently retry lint or invent native proof.

cases.given: Lint POST response lost or job running; caller timeout ends; saved read later retrieves the same lint ID, still unknown.
cases.required_observation: Exit 3 and held unsent work with 0 calls. Same-ID GET recovery only; no replacement lint or paid POST; pending/recovery intent and source/owner guards survive.

cases.given: Two selected tests, one blocked or not checked and one with own passed normal lint plus complete matched supported report; include unrelated inventory refusal and false global coverage flags.
cases.required_observation: Send only the admitted test once with the original selected archive; retain other outcome and diagnostics. Aggregate uses existing exit precedence. No source expansion or second upload capture.

cases.given: Repeat one concrete blocker and one terminal unknown at new check, Try, saved-lint continuation, explicit retry and confirmed restart replacement. Repeat matched support with wrong owner, changed saved source, wrong intent and preexisting dispatch claim.
cases.required_observation: No door bypasses the selected gate or any old guard. Blocked/unknown work is never sent; wrong-owner/source/intent/claim cases remain stopped even when report says supported. Standalone saved lint stays GET-only under its owning contract.

cases.given: Before lint, snapshot approval and behavioral evidence files; use fake source capture/transport spies. Separately seed a paid check whose POST reply is lost with unknown accounting; include capability zero-call data.
cases.required_observation: No wider files, fixture facts, approval changes or new behavioral evidence. Ordinary operational lint receipts remain allowed. Lost paid dispatch gets original-ID reads only and unknown usage, never zero or a repeated POST.

cases.given: Matching structural report identifies configured build, with no verified installed-engine/host/observation evidence. Separately provide a known report/job build disagreement.
cases.required_observation: First case remains structurally eligible under the proposed policy while native readiness is unknown/unproved. Known build disagreement is held not_run/5 with no paid POST. No invented attestation API, profile field or native proof gate.
